params.q: What is the maximum loan amount under PM Mudra Yojana?

search_parameters.q: What is the maximum loan amount under PM Mudra Yojana?

response.markdown:
The maximum loan amount under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is **₹20 lakh**, raised from ₹10 lakh in the Union Budget 2024-25 (effective 24 October 2024). [0] [1] [2] This higher limit falls under the new **Tarun Plus** category, available only to entrepreneurs who have availed and successfully repaid a previous loan under the Tarun category. [0] [1] [3] [4]

The loan categories are:

| Category | Loan Limit |
|---|---|
| Shishu | Up to ₹50,000 |
| Kishore | ₹50,001 – ₹5 lakh |
| Tarun | ₹5 lakh – ₹10 lakh |
| Tarun Plus | ₹10 lakh – ₹20 lakh |

Loans up to ₹20 lakh are collateral-free and carry guarantee coverage under the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU). [4] [1]
